This site describes what the tool does, not what it is intended to do. Where a surface behaves differently from what its name implies, the gap is listed here and cited wherever that surface is documented.

Verified against CLI 1.2.1.

## Open

| ID | Surface | You might expect | What happens | Severity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [KL-001](#kl-001) | `--force` | Existing files are preserved unless --force is passed | Scaffolding overwrites any existing file at a target path whether or not `--force` is passed. The flag is accepted, validated, and never read. | high |
| [KL-002](#kl-002) | `--dry-run` | Every file the run would write is listed | It lists one path per project and one per solution. A real run creates substantially more files than the preview reports. | medium |
| [KL-003](#kl-003) | `template` | The named template is rendered into the file | The key passes schema validation, but content resolution handles only `content` and `source`, so the file is written with no bytes. | medium |
| [KL-004](#kl-004) | `gitInit` | A Git repository is initialized in the output directory | The key is accepted by the schema and validated. No repository is created. | low |
| [KL-005](#kl-005) | `encoding` | The file is written in the named encoding | The key is parsed and validated. Files are always written as UTF-8. | low |
| [KL-006](#kl-006) | `dependencies, devDependencies, features` | Packages are added to the generated project and named features are enabled | All three keys are parsed and validated, then ignored. No package reference or feature is emitted. | medium |
| [KL-007](#kl-007) | `--diagnostics` | Timings are reported whether the run succeeds or fails | On the root command, the report is rendered after the error-handling block, so a failure skips it. Timings are collected and discarded. | low |

### KL-001

**`--force` has no effect.** Scaffolding overwrites any existing file at a target path whether or not `--force` is passed. The flag is accepted, validated, and never read.

- **Classification** — Destructive behavior
- **Surface** — `--force`
- **Present since** — 1.2.1
- **Documented at** — [/cli/scaffold/](/cli/scaffold/)
- **Pinned by** — `ScaffoldOverwritesWithoutForce`

Commit or back up your work before scaffolding into a directory that already contains files. Run with `--dry-run` first to see which paths are targeted.

### KL-002

**`--dry-run` does not list individual files.** It lists one path per project and one per solution. A real run creates substantially more files than the preview reports.

- **Classification** — Known limitation
- **Surface** — `--dry-run`
- **Present since** — 1.2.1
- **Documented at** — [/guides/dry-run/](/guides/dry-run/)
- **Pinned by** — `DryRunPlansProjectDirectoriesNotFiles`

Use `--dry-run` to confirm where output lands, not what is produced. To see the full file set, scaffold into an empty temporary directory and list it.

### KL-003

**`file.template` has no effect and the file is created empty.** The key passes schema validation, but content resolution handles only `content` and `source`, so the file is written with no bytes.

- **Classification** — Known limitation
- **Surface** — `template`
- **Present since** — 1.2.1
- **Documented at** — [/scaffold/files/](/scaffold/files/)
- **Pinned by** — `FileTemplateProducesEmptyFile`

Use `content:` for inline text, or `source:` for a path to an existing file to copy.

### KL-004

**`gitInit` has no effect.** The key is accepted by the schema and validated. No repository is created.

- **Classification** — Not yet implemented
- **Surface** — `gitInit`
- **Present since** — 1.2.1
- **Documented at** — [/scaffold/root/](/scaffold/root/)
- **Pinned by** — `GitInitCreatesNoRepository`

Run `git init` in the output directory yourself, or add it to `postScaffoldCommands`.

### KL-005

**`file.encoding` has no effect.** The key is parsed and validated. Files are always written as UTF-8.

- **Classification** — Not yet implemented
- **Surface** — `encoding`
- **Present since** — 1.2.1
- **Documented at** — [/scaffold/files/](/scaffold/files/)
- **Pinned by** — `FileEncodingIsIgnored`

None required for UTF-8 output. Convert the file in a `postScaffoldCommands` step if another encoding is needed.

### KL-006

**`dependencies`, `devDependencies`, and `features` have no effect.** All three keys are parsed and validated, then ignored. No package reference or feature is emitted.

- **Classification** — Not yet implemented
- **Surface** — `dependencies`, `devDependencies`, `features`
- **Present since** — 1.2.1
- **Documented at** — [/scaffold/projects/](/scaffold/projects/)
- **Pinned by** — `ProjectDependenciesAreIgnored`

Add packages with a `postScaffoldCommands` entry such as `dotnet add package <name>` or `npm install <name>`.

### KL-007

**`--diagnostics` prints nothing when generation fails.** On the root command, the report is rendered after the error-handling block, so a failure skips it. Timings are collected and discarded.

- **Classification** — Known limitation
- **Surface** — `--diagnostics`
- **Present since** — 1.2.1
- **Documented at** — [/guides/diagnostics/](/guides/diagnostics/)
- **Pinned by** — `DiagnosticsSuppressedOnFailure`

Combine with `--verbose` to see the failure detail. Timings for a failing step are available only by re-running the command against a case that succeeds.

None yet. Resolved entries are moved here rather than deleted, so links to them keep working.

## What is not listed

Types that carry no user-visible surface are out of scope. A capability that appears in no command, no option, no schema key, and no error message is not a limitation of the tool, because nothing offers it.
